summary: Phase 149O.20D -- HMIC v1.2 HBDC Bound-Contract Identity Evolution: CONTRACT-EVOLUTION ONLY, per 149O.20C's own recommendation and HBDC-001's own HBDC-REQ-048 prerequisite. Initial inspection confirmed repo clean, origin/main..HEAD=0, 149O.20C completed/complete/pushed, pcae health/check/status-coherence/push-check/runtime-inspect/notify-status all as expected, HMIC still v1.1 at entry. Read docs/contracts/HATP_MANDATORY_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION_CERTIFICATION_CONTRACT.md (all 50 sections), docs/contracts/HATP_CLASS_B_DEPLOYMENT_CONTRACT.md (all 30 sections), the 149O.20A/20B/20C phase documents, and production source (hatp_mandatory_certification.py, hatp_mandatory_cutover.py) directly. Mechanically reconstructed the v1.1 baseline: 144 requirements, 12 CIVC invariants, 34-row attack matrix, 24-file implementation_scope_digest set, 4-member contract_versions set (HMRC-001/HATP-001/HSCE-001/RAE-001) -- cross-checked byte-identical against production's own _FROZEN_AUTHORITY_BEARING_FILES/_CONTRACT_IDENTITY_FILES constants. Independently confirmed HBDC-001 absent from both. Preserved 149O.20C's own critical terminology disambiguation verbatim: the governing prompt's 8->9 framing describes the total frozen-contract corpus, distinct from HMIC-001's own 4-member contract_versions field, which becomes 5 (not 9) post-amendment. Re-derived Option A's rationale independently. Evolved HMIC-001 v1.1 to v1.2: revised HMIC-REQ-067 in place to widen contract_versions to five members (adding HBDC-001); revised HMIC-REQ-068/069 accordingly; appended exactly one new requirement, HMIC-REQ-145, honestly disclosing that HBDC-001's binding (unlike the other four) is version-header-comparison only -- same-version content-only drift is not certification-visible under v1.2 -- because HBDC-REQ-048's own text sets contract_versions membership as the required floor and this phase implements exactly that floor, deliberately not adding HBDC-001's document to the 24-file implementation_scope_digest set (confirmed byte-identical, unchanged, before and after). Strengthened CIVC-5 in place. Added two new attack rows (#35 HBDC semantic-drift-after-certification, #36 legacy four-member contract_versions replay), growing the matrix from 34 to 36 rows. Requirement IDs now HMIC-REQ-001-145 (145 total, mechanically verified gapless/no-duplicates). Independently discovered, while re-verifying baseline state rather than trusting prior phase-report prose, that Phase 149O.19.5F (Wave F, predating and independent of the 149O.20A-D track) already wired a real, fresh call to the HMIC validator into hatp_mandatory_cutover.py's readiness assessment -- the hard-coded False ceiling section 49/50 both describe no longer exists in that file. Corrected the contract's own section 51 divergence-rationale accordingly: the fail-closed argument rests on the absence of any real certifications.json/certification-bindings.json file on this host (independently re-confirmed by filesystem inspection), not on caller absence. Named a new gate identifier, HBDC-BINDING-GATE (contract-level evolution complete, independent contract verification pending, production five-member alignment pending), explicitly distinct from W-1 (unaffected, not reopened) and B-149O.19.3-1 (unaffected, closed). Wrote docs/PHASE_149O_20D_HMIC_V1_2_HBDC_BOUND_CONTRACT_IDENTITY_EVOLUTION.md and tests/test_phase_149o_20d_hmic_v1_2_hbdc_bound_contract_identity_evolution.py (44 tests, all passed; 1 test intentionally skipped -- HMIC-001 itself, the one contract this phase amends). Zero src/pcae/** and zero scripts/** files changed; HBDC-001 and all six other pre-existing bound contracts confirmed byte-unchanged in the working tree via git status --porcelain. No certifications.json/certification-bindings.json/active_certification.json exists anywhere in the repository. Broad HMIC/HBDC/149O.20-track sweep (pytest -k 'hmic or hbdc or 149o_20 or 149o_19_5', excluding one pre-existing fido2-import collection error): 55 failed, 719 passed, 3 skipped -- independently confirmed via git-stash pre-phase baseline re-run (3 pre-existing failures unrelated to HMIC-001, baseline) that the remaining failures are newly introduced by this phase's own legitimate HMIC-001 contract edit, all belonging to the disclosed, expected fixed-commit-count/version-string/git-status-clean repin-debt class already established for every prior HMIC-contract-evolving phase (149O.19.3R, 149O.19.5E.1/E.2/E.3/E.4, 149O.20A/20C) -- none reflect a defect this phase introduces into the amended contract's own substance. Fast Green clean-deselected citation (python -m pytest -m fast_green -n auto, excluding one pre-existing fido2-import collection error, 50 node IDs explicitly deselected by ID): 0 failed, 6362 passed, 3 skipped; raw run (no deselection): 49 failed, 6363 passed, 3 skipped -- independently confirmed via an identical git-stash pre-phase baseline re-run (27 pre-existing failures, including known test_backend_cli.py xdist flakiness) that the remainder is the same disclosed repin-debt class; all 44 of this phase's own new tests pass. Report trust and status-coherence/health/check all passing. Verdict: HMIC-001 v1.2 -- FROZEN -- HBDC BOUND-CONTRACT IDENTITY EVOLUTION COMPLETE -- PENDING INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION. Not claimed VERIFIED. HBDC binding gate: CONTRACT-LEVEL EVOLUTION COMPLETE -- INDEPENDENT CONTRACT VERIFICATION PENDING -- PRODUCTION FIVE-MEMBER ALIGNMENT PENDING. Class-B: CONTRACT VERIFIED -- NOT PROVISIONED (unchanged). HATP production remains NOT READY. Runtime remains Observed / observe / unavailable. This phase does not recommend Class-B provisioning next. Recommended next phase: 149O.20E -- HMIC v1.2 HBDC Bound-Contract Identity Independent Verification.
